title: Basis Senior Analysts
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. -----------------------



The SAP Basis Senior Analyst is a senior technical expert responsible for the administration, stability, performance, and optimization of enterprise SAP landscapes. This role leads complex  

Basis activities, provides advanced troubleshooting, and serves as a technical escalation point while partnering closely with Application, Infrastructure, Security, and Architecture teams.  

The role focuses on operational excellence, system modernization, and reliability across SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments and operates without direct people\-management responsibility.  

This role includes accountability for modern SAP operations, incorporating AIOps, predictive monitoring, and operational automation to proactively detect issues, optimize performance, and improve enterprise system reliability across SAP landscapes.

  

Work Location: Bangalore  

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)  

Shift Timing \- 3:00 PM \- 12:00 AM

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------


**SAP System Administration \& Operations**  

* Administer and support complex SAP landscapes across DEV, QA, and PROD environments
* Lead system copies, client refreshes, upgrades, kernel patches, and support pack implementations
* Manage SAP transports, background jobs, spool systems, and system configurations
* Ensure SAP systems meet availability, performance, and SLA requirements
* Standardize and automate recurring SAP Basis operational activities to improve consistency, scalability, and reliability
* Design and maintain repeatable operational processes supporting enterprise SAP platforms

* Lead structured root\-cause analysis and remediation for production incidents

**Security, Compliance \& Audit Support**

* Support audit activities (e.g., SOX ITGC, access reviews, system controls)

**Change, Transport \& Release Management**

* Ensure compliance with ITIL\-aligned change and release management processes
* Support planned maintenance windows and outage communications
* Implement risk‑based analysis for transport and release activities to minimize production impact

**AIOps \& Intelligent Operations**

title: QA Engineer — Automation (Playwright)
company: K V A Hotel Management LLC
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building a next\-generation enterprise SaaS platform that handles complex operational workflows across multiple business domains. Quality is not a gate at the end of a sprint — it is built into every story from the moment acceptance criteria are written. We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong Playwright automation experience to join our engineering team and help us ship reliable, well\-tested software every sprint.

This is a hands\-on automation role. You will design and maintain our automated test framework, integrate tests into our CI/CD pipeline, and work closely with developers and the Business Analyst to catch defects before they reach production. You will also participate fully in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint\-end quality validation.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Test Automation — Playwright**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases using Playwright as the primary automation framework
* Build and maintain a scalable, reusable automation framework that the team can extend as new modules are delivered
* Automate coverage across functional, regression, smoke, end\-to\-end, and cross\-browser test scenarios
* Identify which test scenarios are suitable for automation and prioritize coverage based on risk and release impact
* Improve automation reliability, execution time, and maintainability continuously — flaky tests are your responsibility to fix

**API \& Data Validation**

* Perform API testing using Playwright API testing, Postman, or REST Assured — validate request/response contracts, status codes, error handling, and edge cases
* Validate data integrity using SQL queries and direct database verification — confirm the backend reflects what the UI shows
* Test integrations between modules and third\-party services to catch contract breaks before they reach production

**CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines so tests run on every pull request and block bad code from merging
* Analyse test failures and distinguish application defects from script issues or environment problems — triage accurately and quickly
* Maintain pipeline health — a broken pipeline is a blocker for the whole team

**Manual Testing \& Defect Management**

* Execute manual test cases for scenarios not yet covered by automation or requiring human judgement
* Log, track, and verify defects in JIRA with enough detail for developers to reproduce and fix without back\-and\-forth
* Participate in defect triage — distinguish product gaps from scope changes and communicate clearly to both sides

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Review user stories and acceptance criteria during refinement — raise testability concerns before development begins, not after
* Participate in sprint\-end demos and provide quality\-related feedback to the team and stakeholders
* Contribute to test strategy, test plans, test scenarios, and release validation documentation
* Collaborate with the Business Analyst to ensure acceptance criteria are specific enough to test, and with developers to troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly

**WHAT YOU MUST BRING**

* 2–4 years in a QA role with a strong focus on test automation — not just manual testing with some automation on the side
* Hands\-on Playwright experience — you have written and maintained a real automation framework, not just run existing scripts
* API testing proficiency using Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright's API testing module
* SQL skills sufficient to write queries that validate backend data without developer help
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar)
* Agile/Scrum experience — you have participated in ceremonies and understand how QA fits into a sprint cadence
* JIRA or equivalent defect tracking — you write bug reports that developers can reproduce on the first read

**WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS applications — you understand how shared infrastructure creates unique test scenarios
* Familiarity with TypeScript or JavaScript — Playwright works best when the tester can write clean, maintainable code
* Prior experience on ERP, HRMS, payroll, or financial software where data accuracy is non\-negotiable
* Knowledge of performance or load testing tools (k6, JMeter, or similar)
* Experience testing REST APIs with complex authentication flows (OAuth2, JWT)
* Exposure to accessibility testing or security testing basics

**DETAILS**

* **Location: Bangalore, India — on\-site**
* **Experience: 2–4 years**
* **Employment: Full time**
* **Primary tool: Playwright**
* **Domain: Enterprise SaaS / Operational Software**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month
